changes: AED SLICE gains CREATE THRESHOLD SLICES, under DELETE ALL SLICES. With Beat Slicer it sits under CREATE BEAT GRID.
Turn the threshold and the gap. A held note stays one slice, a short moment before the hit.
YES asks the usual CREATE SLICES or REPLACE SLICES question. NO leaves the slices alone.
Press LEVEL on the waveform to add one slice at the marker. The marker stays, and the slices already there stay.
Known issue: needs a base that can read the waveform. A long sample still takes a while to scan.
